title: Usual Judgment Entry
description: One mined judgment: a decision the USER made, with reasons and provenance. One JSONL line per entry. The `id` field is added by the exam builder at load time and is NOT stored in the mining JSONL.

id.description: Added by build_exam.py at load time (w<wave>b<batch>:<lineno>). NOT present in mining JSONL.

situation.description: The decision context, neutral third-person, no answer leaked.

call.description: The decision the USER made (not the assistant).

reasons.description: Reasons the user actually gave, verbatim-grounded. May be [] if none stated.

quote.description: Verbatim user words that anchor the call.

confidence.description: Miner's confidence this is a real, non-trivial user judgment.
